reworked_diffusion_policy.visualize_temporal_dataset
====================================================

.. py:module:: reworked_diffusion_policy.visualize_temporal_dataset

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Interactive viser viewer for batches from :class:`RLBenchTemporalH5Dataset`.

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: _prepare_imports() -> None

   Ensure package imports work when the script is launched as a file.


.. py:function:: _split_point_cloud(tensor: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[numpy.ndarray, numpy.ndarray]

   Return ``(points, colors)`` with colours encoded as ``uint8``.

   :param tensor: Point cloud tensor ``(N, C)`` where ``C`` ≥ 3 and optionally ≥ 6.

   :returns: Tuple consisting of XYZ coordinates and colour array.


.. py:function:: _pose_from_tensor(tensor: torch.Tensor) -> Optional[Tuple[numpy.ndarray, numpy.ndarray, Optional[float]]]

   Extract ``(position, quaternion wxyz, gripper)`` from a tensor.

   :param tensor: Action tensor for a single timestep.

   :returns: Tuple containing position, quaternion and optional gripper value or ``None`` when unavailable.


.. py:function:: _update_action_frames(frames: Sequence[viser.FrameHandle], actions: torch.Tensor) -> List[Optional[float]]

   Update viser frames with future gripper poses and return gripper values.

   :param frames: Sequence of viser frames to update in-place.
   :param actions: Action tensor ``(H, D)``.

   :returns: List of gripper openness values per frame (or ``None`` when missing).


.. py:function:: _format_grippers(tag: str, values: Iterable[Optional[float]]) -> str

   Format gripper signals for display.

   :param tag: Label used in the formatted string.
   :param values: Iterable of optional gripper readings.

   :returns: Human-readable summary string.


.. py:function:: parse_args(argv: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None) -> argparse.Namespace

   Parse CLI arguments for the interactive dataset visualiser.

   :param argv: Optional override for ``sys.argv[1:]``.

   :returns: Parsed :class:`argparse.Namespace` with configuration values.


.. py:function:: main(argv: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None) -> None

   Launch the viser-based dataset explorer.

   :param argv: Optional override for ``sys.argv[1:]``.
